name: Joseph
summary: A just man of the house of David who was engaged to Mary, the mother of Jesus. Guided by an angel in dreams, he took Mary as his wife and kept the young child safe.

key_moments.title: Told in a Dream to Take Mary
key_moments.description: When Mary was found to be with child by the Holy Ghost, Joseph planned to end the engagement quietly. An angel told him in a dream not to fear, so he took Mary as his wife and named the baby Jesus.

key_moments.title: Travels to Bethlehem with Mary
key_moments.description: Joseph went from Nazareth to Bethlehem, David's city, to be taxed with Mary. There she gave birth to Jesus and placed Him in a manger.

key_moments.title: Flees to Egypt with the Child
key_moments.description: An angel warned Joseph in a dream that Herod would seek the child to kill Him. Joseph took the child and His mother by night and fled to Egypt.

key_moments.title: Settles in Nazareth
key_moments.description: After Herod died, an angel told Joseph to go back to Israel. Warned again in a dream, he settled in Galilee, in the town of Nazareth.

key_moments.title: Searching for Jesus
key_moments.description: When Jesus was twelve, He stayed behind in Jerusalem after the feast without Joseph and Mary knowing. After three days of searching they found Him in the temple with the teachers.
